subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Citroën DS
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Citroën DS.

hook.text: When the Citroën DS debuted in 1955, people thought it came from another planet.

buildup.text: Its aerodynamic body, hydropneumatic suspension, and swiveling headlights were decades ahead of rivals.

discovery.text: It received 749 orders in the first 15 minutes of its Paris Motor Show debut and 12,000 on day one.

twist.text: The DS was so complex that most mechanics couldn't fix it. Hydraulic leaks were constant and maddening.

climax.text: Roland Barthes compared it to a gothic cathedral. It remains one of the most celebrated car designs ever.

punchline.text: The DS was a spaceship that arrived 20 years too early.

quiz.question: How many orders did the DS receive on its first day?
